## Checklist

- [ ] I ran it from a clean checkout, and it worked
- [ ] Its README states the task, prerequisites, every environment variable, and the exact run command
- [ ] Its README records when I last verified it and against which MutagenT version
- [ ] I added a row to the folder's index table
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, real names, or private URLs — including inside any committed
      `.mutagent/` artifacts

## Showcase entries only

- [ ] `.mutagent/` is committed exactly as the toolchain wrote it, not reformatted or hand-edited
- [ ] I read `.mutagent/traces/` and `.mutagent/diagnostics/` — they quote real inputs verbatim
- [ ] The README states which lifecycle stages the agent actually went through, and which it did not
